name: Shinde mo Tsunage
source:
Jin Tokishiro and the second-ranked girl, Mikana Kujo, discovered a mysterious cabin while exploring uncharted territory.

Days after taking the young girl under their protection, the two are ordered by their superior to act as her parents. Through this family life, Jin remembers the warmth of connecting with others, but soon uncovers the darkness hidden within the Plantation.

Uncover the truth and make your choice for the future!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4995800/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
解代仁与次席少女玖城御奏在探索未知区域时，意外发现了一座神秘的小木屋。

将屋内年幼的女孩收归保护数日后，两人接到了上级下达的命令——要求他们扮演这名女孩的父母。在这段虚假的家庭生活中，仁渐渐找回了人与人之间相连的温暖，却也很快触及了潜藏在“种植园”背后的重重黑暗。

揭开真相，为未来做出你的抉择吧！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4995800/]Steam[/url]]
